texts.nam.1.1: CARGA de Nínive. Libro de la visión de Nahum de Elkosh.
texts.nam.1.2: Dios celoso y vengador es Jehová; vengador es Jehová, y Señor de ira; Jehová, que se venga de sus adversarios, y que guarda enojo para sus enemigos.
texts.nam.1.3: Jehová es tardo para la ira, y grande en poder, y no tendrá al culpado por inocente. Jehová marcha entre la tempestad y turbión, y las nubes son el polvo de sus pies.
texts.nam.1.4: El amenaza á la mar, y la hace secar, y agosta todos los ríos: Basán fué destruído, y el Carmelo, y la flor del Líbano fué destruída.
texts.nam.1.5: Los montes tiemblan de él, y los collados se deslíen; y la tierra se abrasa á su presencia, y el mundo, y todos los que en él habitan.
texts.nam.1.6: ¿Quién permanecerá delante de su ira? ¿y quién quedará en pié en el furor de su enojo? Su ira se derrama como fuego, y por él se hienden las peñas.
texts.nam.1.7: Bueno es Jehová para fortaleza en el día de la angustia; y conoce á los que en él confían.
texts.nam.1.8: Mas con inundación impetuosa hará consumación de su lugar, y tinieblas perseguirán á sus enemigos.
texts.nam.1.9: ¿Qué pensáis contra Jehová? El hará consumación: la tribulación no se levantará dos veces.
texts.nam.1.10: Porque como espinas entretegidas, mientras se embriagarán los borrachos, serán consumidos como las estopas llenas de sequedad.
texts.nam.1.11: De ti salió el que pensó mal contra Jehová, un consultor impío.
texts.nam.1.12: Así ha dicho Jehová: Aunque reposo tengan, y sean tantos, así serán talados, y él pasará. Bien que te he afligido, no más te afligiré.
texts.nam.1.13: Porque ahora quebraré su yugo de sobre ti, y romperé tus coyundas.
texts.nam.1.14: Mas acerca de ti mandará Jehová, que nunca más sea sembrado alguno de tu nombre: de la casa de tu dios talaré escultura y estatua de fundición, haréla tu sepulcro; porque fuiste vil.
texts.nam.1.15: He aquí sobre los montes los pies del que trae buenas nuevas, del que pregona la paz. Celebra, oh Judá, tus fiestas, cumple tus votos: porque nunca más pasará por ti el malvado; pereció del todo.
texts.nam.2.1: SUBIO destruidor contra ti: guarda la fortaleza, mira el camino, fortifica los lomos, fortalece mucho la fuerza.
texts.nam.2.2: Porque Jehová restituirá la gloria de Jacob como la gloria de Israel; porque vaciadores los vaciaron, y estropearon sus mugrones.
texts.nam.2.3: El escudo de sus valientes será bermejo, los varones de su ejército vestidos de grana: el carro como fuego de hachas; el día que se aparejará, temblarán las hayas.
texts.nam.2.4: Los carros se precipitarán á las plazas, discurrirán por las calles: su aspecto como hachas encendidas; correrán como relámpagos.
texts.nam.2.5: Acordaráse él de sus valientes; andando tropezarán; se apresurarán á su muro, y la cubierta se aparejará.
texts.nam.2.6: Las puertas de los ríos se abrirán, y el palacio será destruido.
texts.nam.2.7: Y la reina fué cautiva; mandarle han que suba, y sus criadas la llevarán gimiendo como palomas, batiendo sus pechos.
texts.nam.2.8: Y fué Nínive de tiempo antiguo como estanque de aguas; mas ellos huyen: Parad, parad; y ninguno mira.
texts.nam.2.9: Saquead plata, saquead oro: no hay fin de las riquezas y suntuosidad de todo ajuar de codicia.
texts.nam.2.10: Vacía, y agotada, y despedazada está, y el corazón derretido: batimiento de rodillas, y dolor en todos riñones, y los rostros de todos tomarán negrura.
texts.nam.2.11: ¿Qué es de la morada de los leones, y de la majada de los cachorros de los leones, donde se recogía el león, y la leona, y los cachorros del león, y no había quien les pusiese miedo?
texts.nam.2.12: El león arrebataba en abundancia para sus cachorros, y ahogaba para sus leonas, y henchía de presa sus cavernas, y de robo sus moradas.
texts.nam.2.13: Heme aquí contra ti, dice Jehová de los ejércitos. Encenderé y reduciré á humo tus carros, y espada devorará tus leoncillos; y raeré de la tierra tu robo, y nunca más se oirá voz de tus embajadores.
texts.nam.3.1: AY de la ciudad de sangres, toda llena de mentira y de rapiña, sin apartarse de ella el pillaje!
texts.nam.3.2: Sonido de látigo, y estruendo de movimiento de ruedas; y caballo atropellador, y carro saltador;
texts.nam.3.3: Caballero enhiesto, y resplandor de espada, y resplandor de lanza; y multitud de muertos, y multitud de cadáveres; y de sus cadáveres no habrá fin, y en sus cadáveres tropezarán:
texts.nam.3.4: A causa de la multitud de las fornicaciones de la ramera de hermosa gala, maestra de brujerías, que vende las gentes con sus fornicaciones, y los pueblos con sus hechizos.
texts.nam.3.5: Heme aquí contra ti, dice Jehová de los ejércitos, y descubriré tus faldas en tu cara, y mostraré á las gentes tu desnudez, y á los reinos tu vergüenza.
texts.nam.3.6: Y echaré sobre ti suciedades, y te afrentaré, y te pondré como estiércol.
texts.nam.3.7: Y será que todos los que te vieren, se apartarán de ti, y dirán: Nínive es asolada: ¿quién se compadecerá de ella? ¿dónde te buscaré consoladores?
texts.nam.3.8: ¿Eres tú mejor que No-amón, que estaba asentada entre ríos, cercada de aguas, cuyo baluarte era la mar, y del mar su muralla?
texts.nam.3.9: Etiopía era su fortaleza, y Egipto sin límite; Put y Libia fueron en tu ayuda.
texts.nam.3.10: También ella fué llevada en cautiverio: también sus chiquitos fueron estrellados en las encrucijadas de todas las calles; y sobre sus varones echaron suertes, y todos sus magnates fueron aprisionados con grillos.
texts.nam.3.11: Tú también serás embriagada, serás encerrada; tú también buscarás fortaleza á causa del enemigo.
texts.nam.3.12: Todas tus fortalezas cual higueras con brevas; que si las sacuden, caen en la boca del que las ha de comer.
texts.nam.3.13: He aquí, tu pueblo será como mujeres en medio de ti: las puertas de tu tierra se abrirán de par en par á tus enemigos: fuego consumirá tus barras.
texts.nam.3.14: Provéete de agua para el cerco, fortifica tus fortalezas; entra en el lodo, pisa el barro, fortifica el horno.
texts.nam.3.15: Allí te consumirá el fuego, te talará la espada, te devorará como pulgón: multiplícate como langosta, multiplícate como langosta.
texts.nam.3.16: Multiplicaste tus mercaderes más que las estrellas del cielo: el pulgón hizo presa, y voló.
texts.nam.3.17: Tus príncipes serán como langostas, y tus grandes como langostas de langostas que se sientan en vallados en día de frío: salido el sol se mudan, y no se conoce el lugar donde estuvieron.
texts.nam.3.18: Durmieron tus pastores, oh rey de Asiria, reposaron tus valientes: tu pueblo se derramó por los montes, y no hay quien lo junte.
texts.nam.3.19: No hay cura para tu quebradura; tu herida se encrudeció: todos los que oyeron tu fama, batirán las manos sobre ti, porque ¿sobre quién no pasó continuamente tu malicia?

texts.nam.1.1: The burden of Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.
texts.nam.1.2: Jehovah is a jealous God and avengeth; Jehovah avengeth and is full of wrath; Jehovah taketh vengeance on his adversaries, and he reserveth [wrath] for his enemies.
texts.nam.1.3: Jehovah is slow to anger, and great in power, and will by no means clear [the guilty]: Jehovah hath his way in the whirlwind and in the storm, and the clouds are the dust of his feet.
texts.nam.1.4: He rebuketh the sea, and maketh it dry, and drieth up all the rivers: Bashan languisheth, and Carmel; and the flower of Lebanon languisheth.
texts.nam.1.5: The mountains quake at him, and the hills melt; and the earth is upheaved at his presence, yea, the world, and all that dwell therein.
texts.nam.1.6: Who can stand before his indignation? and who can abide in the fierceness of his anger? his wrath is poured out like fire, and the rocks are broken asunder by him.
texts.nam.1.7: Jehovah is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that take refuge in him.
texts.nam.1.8: But with an over-running flood he will make a full end of her place, and will pursue his enemies into darkness.
texts.nam.1.9: What do ye devise against Jehovah? he will make a full end; affliction shall not rise up the second time.
texts.nam.1.10: For entangled like thorns, and drunken as with their drink, they are consumed utterly as dry stubble.
texts.nam.1.11: There is one gone forth out of thee, that deviseth evil against Jehovah, that counselleth wickedness.
texts.nam.1.12: Thus saith Jehovah: Though they be in full strength, and likewise many, even so shall they be cut down, and he shall pass away. Though I have afflicted thee, I will afflict thee no more.
texts.nam.1.13: And now will I break his yoke from off thee, and will burst thy bonds in sunder.
texts.nam.1.14: And Jehovah hath given commandment concerning thee, that no more of thy name be sown: out of the house of thy gods will I cut off the graven image and the molten image; I will make thy grave; for thou art vile.
texts.nam.1.15: Behold, upon the mountains the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace! Keep thy feasts, O Judah, perform thy vows; for the wicked one shall no more pass through thee; he is utterly cut off.
texts.nam.2.1: He that dasheth in pieces is come up against thee: keep the fortress, watch the way, make thy loins strong, fortify thy power mightily.
texts.nam.2.2: For Jehovah restoreth the excellency of Jacob, as the excellency of Israel; for the emptiers have emptied them out, and destroyed their vine-branches.
texts.nam.2.3: The shield of his mighty men is made red, the valiant men are in scarlet: the chariots flash with steel in the day of his preparation, and the cypress [spears] are brandished.
texts.nam.2.4: The chariots rage in the streets; they rush to and fro in the broad ways: the appearance of them is like torches; they run like the lightnings.
texts.nam.2.5: He remembereth his nobles: they stumble in their march; they make haste to the wall thereof, and the mantelet is prepared.
texts.nam.2.6: The gates of the rivers are opened, and the palace is dissolved.
texts.nam.2.7: And it is decreed: she is uncovered, she is carried away; and her handmaids moan as with the voice of doves, beating upon their breasts.
texts.nam.2.8: But Nineveh hath been from of old like a pool of water: yet they flee away. Stand, stand, [they cry]; but none looketh back.
texts.nam.2.9: Take ye the spoil of silver, take the spoil of gold; for there is no end of the store, the glory of all goodly furniture.
texts.nam.2.10: She is empty, and void, and waste; and the heart melteth, and the knees smite together, and anguish is in all loins, and the faces of them all are waxed pale.
texts.nam.2.11: Where is the den of the lions, and the feeding-place of the young lions, where the lion [and] the lioness walked, the lion's whelp, and none made them afraid?
texts.nam.2.12: The lion did tear in pieces enough for his whelps, and strangled for his lionesses, and filled his caves with prey, and his dens with ravin.
texts.nam.2.13: Behold, I am against thee, saith Jehovah of hosts, and I will burn her chariots in the smoke, and the sword shall devour thy young lions; and I will cut off thy prey from the earth, and the voice of thy messengers shall no more be heard.
texts.nam.3.1: Woe to the bloody city! it is all full of lies and rapine; the prey departeth not.
texts.nam.3.2: The noise of the whip, and the noise of the rattling of wheels, and prancing horses, and bounding chariots,
texts.nam.3.3: the horseman mounting, and the flashing sword, and the glittering spear, and a multitude of slain, and a great heap of corpses, and there is no end of the bodies; they stumble upon their bodies;-
texts.nam.3.4: because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the well-favored harlot, the mistress of witchcrafts, that selleth nations through her whoredoms, and families through her witchcrafts.
texts.nam.3.5: Behold, I am against thee, saith Jehovah of hosts, and I will uncover thy skirts upon thy face; and I will show the nations thy nakedness, and the kingdoms thy shame.
texts.nam.3.6: And I will cast abominable filth upon thee, and make thee vile, and will set thee as a gazing-stock.
texts.nam.3.7: And it shall come to pass, that all they that look upon thee shall flee from thee, and say, Nineveh is laid waste: who will bemoan her? whence shall I seek comforters for thee?
texts.nam.3.8: Art thou better than No-amon, that was situate among the rivers, that had the waters round about her; whose rampart was the sea, [and] her wall was of the sea?
texts.nam.3.9: Ethiopia and Egypt were her strength, and it was infinite; Put and Lubim were thy helpers.
texts.nam.3.10: Yet was she carried away, she went into captivity; her young children also were dashed in pieces at the head of all the streets; and they cast lots for her honorable men, and all her great men were bound in chains.
texts.nam.3.11: Thou also shalt be drunken; thou shalt be hid; thou also shalt seek a stronghold because of the enemy.
texts.nam.3.12: All thy fortresses shall be [like] fig-trees with the first-ripe figs: if they be shaken, they fall into the mouth of the eater.
texts.nam.3.13: Behold, thy people in the midst of thee are women; the gates of thy land are set wide open unto thine enemies: the fire hath devoured thy bars.
texts.nam.3.14: Draw thee water for the siege; strengthen thy fortresses; go into the clay, and tread the mortar; make strong the brickkiln.
texts.nam.3.15: There shall the fire devour thee; the sword shall cut thee off; it shall devour thee like the canker-worm: make thyself many as the canker-worm; make thyself many as the locust.
texts.nam.3.16: Thou hast multiplied thy merchants above the stars of heaven: the canker-worm ravageth, and fleeth away.
texts.nam.3.17: Thy princes are as the locusts, and thy marshals as the swarms of grasshoppers, which encamp in the hedges in the cold day, but when the sun ariseth they flee away, and their place is not known where they are.
texts.nam.3.18: Thy shepherds slumber, O king of Assyria; thy nobles are at rest; thy people are scattered upon the mountains, and there is none to gather them.
texts.nam.3.19: There is no assuaging of thy hurt: thy wound is grievous: all that hear the report of thee clap their hands over thee; for upon whom hath not thy wickedness passed continually?

texts.nam.1.1: Oracle sur Ninive. Livre de la prophétie de Nahum, d'Elkosch.
texts.nam.1.2: L'Eternel est un Dieu jaloux, il se venge; L'Eternel se venge, il est plein de fureur; L'Eternel se venge de ses adversaires, Il garde rancune à ses ennemis.
texts.nam.1.3: L'Eternel est lent à la colère, il est grand par sa force; Il ne laisse pas impuni. L'Eternel marche dans la tempête, dans le tourbillon; Les nuées sont la poussière de ses pieds.
texts.nam.1.4: Il menace la mer et la dessèche, Il fait tarir tous les fleuves; Le Basan et le Carmel languissent, La fleur du Liban se flétrit.
texts.nam.1.5: Les montagnes s'ébranlent devant lui, Et les collines se fondent; La terre se soulève devant sa face, Le monde et tous ses habitants.
texts.nam.1.6: Qui résistera devant sa fureur? Qui tiendra contre son ardente colère? Sa fureur se répand comme le feu, Et les rochers se brisent devant lui.
texts.nam.1.7: L'Eternel est bon, Il est un refuge au jour de la détresse; Il connaît ceux qui se confient en lui.
texts.nam.1.8: Mais avec des flots qui déborderont Il détruira la ville, Et il poursuivra ses ennemis jusque dans les ténèbres.
texts.nam.1.9: Que méditez-vous contre l'Eternel? C'est lui qui détruit. La détresse ne paraîtra pas deux fois.
texts.nam.1.10: Car entrelacés comme des épines, Et comme ivres de leur vin, Ils seront consumés Comme la paille sèche, entièrement.
texts.nam.1.11: De toi est sorti Celui qui méditait le mal contre l'Eternel, Celui qui avait de méchants desseins.
texts.nam.1.12: Ainsi parle l'Eternel: Quoique intacts et nombreux, Ils seront moissonnés et disparaîtront. Je veux t'humilier, Pour ne plus avoir à t'humilier...
texts.nam.1.13: Je briserai maintenant son joug de dessus toi, Et je romprai tes liens...
texts.nam.1.14: Voici ce qu'a ordonné sur toi l'Eternel: Tu n'auras plus de descendants qui portent ton nom; J'enlèverai de la maison de ton dieu les images taillées ou en fonte; Je préparerai ton sépulcre, car tu es trop léger.
texts.nam.1.15: Voici sur les montagnes Les pieds du messager qui annonce la paix! Célèbre tes fêtes, Juda, accomplis tes voeux! Car le méchant ne passera plus au milieu de toi, Il est entièrement exterminé...
texts.nam.2.1: Le destructeur marche contre toi. Garde la forteresse! Veille sur la route! affermis tes reins! Recueille toute ta force!...
texts.nam.2.2: Car l'Eternel rétablit la gloire de Jacob Et la gloire d'Israël, Parce que les pillards les ont pillés Et ont détruit leurs ceps....
texts.nam.2.3: Les boucliers de ses héros sont rouges, Les guerriers sont vêtus de pourpre; Avec le fer qui étincelle apparaissent les chars, Au jour qu'il a fixé pour la bataille, Et les lances sont agitées.
texts.nam.2.4: Les chars s'élancent dans la campagne, Se précipitent sur les places; A les voir, on dirait des flambeaux, Ils courent comme des éclairs...
texts.nam.2.5: Il se souvient de ses vaillants hommes, Mais ils chancellent dans leur marche; On se hâte vers les murs, Et l'on se prépare à la défense....
texts.nam.2.6: Les portes des fleuves sont ouvertes, Et le palais s'écroule!...
texts.nam.2.7: C'en est fait: elle est mise à nu, elle est emmenée; Ses servantes gémissent comme des colombes, Et se frappent la poitrine.
texts.nam.2.8: Ninive était jadis comme un réservoir plein d'eau.... Les voilà qui fuient.... Arrêtez! arrêtez!... Mais nul ne se retourne....
texts.nam.2.9: Pillez l'argent! pillez l'or! Il y a des trésors sans fin, Des richesses en objets précieux de toute espèce.
texts.nam.2.10: On pille, on dévaste, on ravage! Et les coeurs sont abattus, Les genoux chancellent, Tous les reins souffrent, Tous les visages pâlissent.
texts.nam.2.11: Qu'est devenu ce repaire de lions, Ce pâturage des lionceaux, Où se retiraient le lion, la lionne, le petit du lion, Sans qu'il y eût personne pour les troubler?
texts.nam.2.12: Le lion déchirait pour ses petits, Etranglait pour ses lionnes; Il remplissait de proie ses antres, De dépouilles ses repaires.
texts.nam.2.13: Voici, j'en veux à toi, dit l'Eternel des armées; Je réduirai tes chars en fumée, L'épée dévorera tes lionceaux, J'arracherai du pays ta proie, Et l'on n'entendra plus la voix de tes messagers.
texts.nam.3.1: Malheur à la ville sanguinaire, Pleine de mensonge, pleine de violence, Et qui ne cesse de se livrer à la rapine!...
texts.nam.3.2: On entend le bruit du fouet, Le bruit des roues, Le galop des chevaux, Le roulement des chars.
texts.nam.3.3: Les cavaliers s'élancent, l'épée étincelle, la lance brille... Une multitude de blessés!... une foule de cadavres!... Des morts à l'infini!... On tombe sur les morts!...
texts.nam.3.4: C'est à cause des nombreuses prostitutions de la prostituée, Pleine d'attraits, habile enchanteresse, Qui vendait les nations par ses prostitutions Et les peuples par ses enchantements.
texts.nam.3.5: Voici, j'en veux à toi, dit l'Eternel des armées, Je relèverai tes pans jusque sur ton visage, Je montrerai ta nudité aux nations, Et ta honte aux royaumes.
texts.nam.3.6: Je jetterai sur toi des impuretés, je t'avilirai, Et je te donnerai en spectacle.
texts.nam.3.7: Tous ceux qui te verront fuiront loin de toi, Et l'on dira: Ninive est détruite! Qui la plaindra? Où te chercherai-je des consolateurs?
texts.nam.3.8: Es-tu meilleure que No-Amon, Qui était assise au milieu des fleuves, Entourée par les eaux, Ayant la mer pour rempart, La mer pour murailles?
texts.nam.3.9: L'Ethiopie et les Egyptiens innombrables faisaient sa force, Puth et les Libyens étaient ses auxiliaires.
texts.nam.3.10: Et cependant elle est partie pour l'exil, elle s'en est allée captive; Ses enfants ont été écrasés au coin de toutes les rues; On a jeté le sort sur ses nobles, Et tous ses grands ont été chargés de chaînes.
texts.nam.3.11: Toi aussi, tu seras enivrée, tu te cacheras; Toi aussi, tu chercheras un refuge contre l'ennemi.
texts.nam.3.12: Toutes tes forteresses Sont des figuiers avec les primeurs; Quand on les secoue, Elles tombent dans la bouche de qui veut les manger.
texts.nam.3.13: Voici, ton peuple, ce sont des femmes au milieu de toi; Les portes de ton pays s'ouvrent à tes ennemis; Le feu consume tes verrous.
texts.nam.3.14: Puise de l'eau pour le siège! Répare tes forteresses! Entre dans la boue, foule l'argile! Rétablis le four à briques!
texts.nam.3.15: Là, le feu te dévorera, L'épée t'exterminera, Te dévorera comme des sauterelles. Entasse-toi comme les sauterelles! Entasse-toi comme les sauterelles!
texts.nam.3.16: Tes marchands, plus nombreux Que les étoiles du ciel, Sont comme la sauterelle qui ouvre les ailes et s'envole.
texts.nam.3.17: Tes princes sont comme les sauterelles, Tes chefs comme une multitude de sauterelles, Qui se posent sur les haies au temps de la froidure: Le soleil paraît, elles s'envolent, Et l'on ne connaît plus le lieu où elles étaient.
texts.nam.3.18: Tes bergers sommeillent, roi d'Assyrie, Tes vaillants hommes reposent; Ton peuple est dispersé sur les montagnes, Et nul ne le rassemble.
texts.nam.3.19: Il n'y a point de remède à ta blessure, Ta plaie est mortelle. Tous ceux qui entendront parler de toi Battront des mains sur toi; Car quel est celui que ta méchanceté n'a pas atteint?

texts.nam.1.1: Dies ist die Last über Ninive und das Buch der Weissagung Nahums von Elkos.
texts.nam.1.2: Der HERR ist ein eifriger Gott und ein Rächer, ja, ein Rächer ist der HERR und zornig; der HERR ist ein Rächer wider seine Widersacher und der es seinen Feinden nicht vergessen wird.
texts.nam.1.3: Der HERR ist geduldig und von großer Kraft, vor welchem niemand unschuldig ist; er ist der HERR, des Weg in Wetter und Sturm ist und Gewölke der Staub unter seinen Füßen,
texts.nam.1.4: der das Meer schilt und trocken macht und alle Wasser vertrocknet. Basan und Karmel verschmachten; und was auf dem Berge Libanon blüht, verschmachtet.
texts.nam.1.5: Die Berge zittern vor ihm, und die Hügel zergehen; das Erdreich bebt vor ihm, der Weltkreis und alle, die darauf wohnen.
texts.nam.1.6: Wer kann vor seinem Zorn stehen, und wer kann seinen Grimm bleiben? Sein Zorn brennt wie Feuer, und die Felsen zerspringen vor ihm.
texts.nam.1.7: Der HERR ist gütig und eine Feste zur Zeit der Not und kennt die, die auf ihn trauen.
texts.nam.1.8: Er läßt die Flut überher laufen und macht derselben Stätte ein Ende, und seine Feinde verfolgt er mit Finsternis.
texts.nam.1.9: Was gedenkt ihr wider den HERRN? Er wird doch ein Ende machen; es wird das Unglück nicht zweimal kommen.
texts.nam.1.10: Denn wenn sie gleich sind wie die Dornen, die noch ineinanderwachsen und im besten Saft sind, so sollen sie doch verbrannt werden wie dürres Stroh.
texts.nam.1.11: Denn von dir ist gekommen der Schalksrat, der Böses wider den HERRN gedachte.
texts.nam.1.12: So spricht der HERR: Sie kommen so gerüstet und mächtig, wie sie wollen, so sollen sie doch umgehauen werden und dahinfahren. Ich habe dich gedemütigt; aber ich will dich nicht wiederum demütigen.
texts.nam.1.13: Alsdann will ich sein Joch, das du trägst, zerbrechen und deine Bande zerreißen.
texts.nam.1.14: Aber wider dich hat der HERR geboten, daß deines Namens kein Same mehr soll bleiben. Vom Hause deines Gottes will ich dich ausrotten, die Götzen und Bilder will ich dir zum Grab machen; denn du bist zunichte geworden.
texts.nam.1.15: Siehe, auf den Bergen kommen Füße eines guten Boten, der da Frieden verkündigt! Halte deine Feiertage, Juda, und bezahle deine Gelübde! denn es wird der Arge nicht mehr über dich kommen; er ist ganz ausgerottet.
texts.nam.2.1: Es wird der Zerstreuer wider dich heraufziehen und die Feste belagern. Siehe wohl auf die Straße, rüste dich aufs beste und stärke dich aufs gewaltigste!
texts.nam.2.2: Denn der HERR wird die Pracht Jakobs wiederbringen wie die Pracht Israels; denn die Ableser haben sie abgelesen und ihre Reben verderbt.
texts.nam.2.3: Die Schilde seiner Starken sind rot, sein Heervolk glänzt wie Purpur, seine Wagen leuchten wie Feuer, wenn er sich rüstet; ihre Spieße beben.
texts.nam.2.4: Die Wagen rollen auf den Gassen und rasseln auf den Straßen; sie glänzen wie Fackeln und fahren einher wie die Blitze.
texts.nam.2.5: Er aber wird an seine Gewaltigen gedenken; doch werden sie fallen, wo sie hinaus wollen, und werden eilen zur Mauer und zu dem Schirm, da sie sicher seien.
texts.nam.2.6: Aber die Tore an den Wassern werden doch geöffnet, und der Palast wird untergehen.
texts.nam.2.7: Die Königin wird gefangen weggeführt werden, und ihre Jungfrauen werden seufzen wie die Tauben und an ihre Brust schlagen.
texts.nam.2.8: Denn Ninive ist wie ein Teich voll Wasser von jeher; aber dasselbe wird verfließen müssen. "Stehet, stehet!" werden sie rufen; aber da wird sich niemand umwenden.
texts.nam.2.9: So raubet nun Silber! raubet Gold! denn hier ist der Schätze kein Ende und die Menge aller köstlichen Kleinode.
texts.nam.2.10: Nun muß sie rein abgelesen und geplündert werden, daß ihr Herz muß verzagen, die Kniee schlottern, alle Lenden zittern und alle Angesichter bleich werden.
texts.nam.2.11: Wo ist nun die Wohnung der Löwen und die Weide der jungen Löwen, da der Löwe und die Löwin mit den jungen Löwen wandelten, und niemand durfte sie scheuchen?
texts.nam.2.12: Der Löwe raubte genug für seine Jungen und würgte es für seine Löwinnen; seine Höhlen füllte er mit Raub und seine Wohnung mit dem, was er zerrissen hatte.
texts.nam.2.13: Siehe, ich will an dich, spricht der HERR Zebaoth, und deine Wagen im Rauch anzünden, und das Schwert soll deine jungen Löwen fressen; und will deines Raubens ein Ende machen auf Erden, daß man deiner Boten Stimme nicht mehr hören soll.
texts.nam.3.1: Weh der mörderischen Stadt, die voll Lügen und Räuberei ist und von ihrem Rauben nicht lassen will!
texts.nam.3.2: Denn da wird man hören die Geißeln klappen und die Räder rasseln und die Rosse jagen und die Wagen rollen.
texts.nam.3.3: Reiter rücken herauf mit glänzenden Schwertern und blitzenden Spießen. Da liegen viel Erschlagene und große Haufen Leichname, daß ihrer keine Zahl ist und man über die Leichname fallen muß.
texts.nam.3.4: Das alles um der Hurerei willen der schönen, lieben Hure, die mit Zauberei umgeht, die mit ihrer Hurerei die Heiden und mit ihrer Zauberei Land und Leute zu Knechten gemacht hat.
texts.nam.3.5: Siehe, ich will an dich, spricht der HERR Zebaoth; ich will dir deine Säume aufdecken unter dein Angesicht und will den Heiden deine Blöße und den Königreichen deine Schande zeigen.
texts.nam.3.6: Ich will dich ganz greulich machen und dich schänden und ein Schauspiel aus dir machen,
texts.nam.3.7: daß alle, die dich sehen, vor dir fliehen und sagen sollen: Ninive ist zerstört; wer will Mitleid mit ihr haben? Und wo soll ich dir Tröster suchen?
texts.nam.3.8: Meinst du, du seist besser denn die Stadt No-Amon, die da lag an den Wassern und ringsumher Wasser hatte, deren Mauern und Feste war das Meer?
texts.nam.3.9: Mohren und Ägypten war ihre unzählige Macht, Put und Libyen waren ihre Hilfe.
texts.nam.3.10: Doch hat sie müssen vertrieben werden und gefangen wegziehen; und sind ihre Kinder auf allen Gassen zerschmettert worden, und um ihre Edlen warf man das Los, und alle ihre Gewaltigen wurden in Ketten und Fesseln gelegt.
texts.nam.3.11: Also mußt du auch trunken werden und dich verbergen und eine Feste suchen vor dem Feinde.
texts.nam.3.12: Alle deine festen Städte sind wie Feigenbäume mit reifen Feigen, die, wenn man sie schüttelt, dem ins Maul fallen, der sie essen will.
texts.nam.3.13: Siehe, dein Volk soll zu Weibern werden in dir, und die Tore deines Landes sollen deinen Feinden geöffnet werden, und das Feuer soll deine Riegel verzehren.
texts.nam.3.14: Schöpfe dir Wasser, denn du wirst belagert werden! Bessere deine Festen! Gehe in den Ton und tritt den Lehm und mache starke Ziegel!
texts.nam.3.15: Aber das Feuer wir dich fressen und das Schwert töten; es wird dich abfressen wie ein Käfer, ob deines Volkes schon viel ist wie Käfer, ob deines Volkes schon viel ist wie Heuschrecken.
texts.nam.3.16: Du hast mehr Händler, denn Sterne am Himmel sind; aber nun werden sie sich ausbreiten wie Käfer und davonfliegen.
texts.nam.3.17: Deiner Herden sind so viel wie Heuschrecken und deiner Hauptleute wie Käfer, die sich an die Zäune lagern in den kalten Tagen; wenn aber die Sonne aufgeht, heben sie sich davon, daß man nicht weiß, wo sie bleiben.
texts.nam.3.18: Deine Hirten werden schlafen, o König zu Assur, deine Mächtigen werden sich legen; und dein Volk wird auf den Bergen zerstreut sein, und niemand wird sie versammeln.
texts.nam.3.19: Niemand wird deinen Schaden lindern, und deine Wunde wird unheilbar sein. Alle, die solches von dir hören, werden mit ihren Händen über dich klatschen; denn über wen ist nicht deine Bosheit ohne Unterlaß gegangen?

texts.nam.1.1: Пророчество о Ниневии; книга видений Наума Елкосеянина.
texts.nam.1.2: Господь есть Бог ревнитель и мститель; мститель Господь и страшен в гневе: мстит Господь врагам Своим и не пощадит противников Своих.
texts.nam.1.3: Господь долготерпелив и велик могуществом, и не оставляет без наказания; в вихре и в буре шествие Господа, облако - пыль от ног Его.
texts.nam.1.4: Запретит Он морю, и оно высыхает, и все реки иссякают; вянет Васан и Кармил, и блекнет цвет на Ливане.
texts.nam.1.5: Горы трясутся пред Ним, и холмы тают, и земля колеблется пред лицем Его, и вселенная и все живущие в ней.
texts.nam.1.6: Пред негодованием Его кто устоит? И кто стерпит пламя гнева Его? Гнев Его разливается как огонь; скалы распадаются пред Ним.
texts.nam.1.7: Благ Господь, убежище в день скорби, и знает надеющихся на Него.
texts.nam.1.8: Но всепотопляющим наводнением разрушит до основания Ниневию, и врагов Его постигнет мрак.
texts.nam.1.9: Что умышляете вы против Господа? Он совершит истребление, и бедствие уже не повторится,
texts.nam.1.10: ибо сплетшиеся между собою как терновник и упившиеся как пьяницы, они пожраны будут совершенно, как сухая солома.
texts.nam.1.11: Из тебя произошел умысливший злое против Господа, составивший совет нечестивый.
texts.nam.1.12: Так говорит Господь: хотя они безопасны и многочисленны, но они будут посечены и исчезнут; а тебя, хотя Я отягощал, более не буду отягощать.
texts.nam.1.13: И ныне Я сокрушу ярмо его, лежащее на тебе, и узы твои разорву.
texts.nam.1.14: А о тебе, Ассур, Господь определил: не будет более семени с твоим именем; из дома бога твоего истреблю истуканов и кумиров; приготовлю тебе в нем могилу, потому что ты будешь в презрении.
texts.nam.1.15: Вот, на горах - стопы благовестника, возвещающего мир: празднуй, Иудея, праздники твои, исполняй обеты твои, ибо не будет более проходить по тебе нечестивый: он совсем уничтожен.
texts.nam.2.1: Поднимается на тебя разрушитель: охраняй твердыни, стереги дорогу, укрепи чресла, собирайся с силами.
texts.nam.2.2: Ибо восстановит Господь величие Иакова, как величие Израиля, потому что опустошили их опустошители и виноградные ветви их истребили.
texts.nam.2.3: Щит героев его красен; воины его в одеждах багряных; огнем сверкают колесницы в день приготовления к бою, и лес копьев волнуется.
texts.nam.2.4: По улицам несутся колесницы, гремят на площадях; блеск от них, как от огня; сверкают, как молния.
texts.nam.2.5: Он вызывает храбрых своих, но они спотыкаются на ходу своем; поспешают на стены города, но осада уже устроена.
texts.nam.2.6: Речные ворота отворяются, и дворец разрушается.
texts.nam.2.7: Решено: она будет обнажена и отведена в плен, и рабыни ее будут стонать как голуби, ударяя себя в грудь.
texts.nam.2.8: Ниневия со времени существования своего была как пруд, полный водою, а они бегут. "Стойте, стойте!" Но никто не оглядывается.
texts.nam.2.9: Расхищайте серебро, расхищайте золото! нет конца запасам всякой драгоценной утвари.
texts.nam.2.10: Разграблена, опустошена и разорена она, - и тает сердце, колени трясутся; у всех в чреслах сильная боль, и лица у всех потемнели.
texts.nam.2.11: Где теперь логовище львов и то пастбище для львенков, по которому ходил лев, львица и львенок, и никто не пугал их, -
texts.nam.2.12: лев, похищающий для насыщения щенков своих, и задушающий для львиц своих, и наполняющий добычею пещеры свои и логовища свои похищенным?
texts.nam.2.13: Вот, Я - на тебя! говорит Господь Саваоф. И сожгу в дыму колесницы твои, и меч пожрет львенков твоих, и истреблю с земли добычу твою, и не будет более слышим голос послов твоих.
texts.nam.3.1: Горе городу кровей! весь он полон обмана и убийства; не прекращается в нем грабительство.
texts.nam.3.2: Слышны хлопанье бича и стук крутящихся колес, ржание коня и грохот скачущей колесницы.
texts.nam.3.3: Несется конница, сверкает меч и блестят копья; убитых множество и груды трупов: нет конца трупам, спотыкаются о трупы их.
texts.nam.3.4: Это - за многие блудодеяния развратницы приятной наружности, искусной в чародеянии, которая блудодеяниями своими продает народы и чарованиями своими - племена.
texts.nam.3.5: Вот, Я - на тебя! говорит Господь Саваоф. И подниму на лице твое края одежды твоей и покажу народам наготу твою и царствам срамоту твою.
texts.nam.3.6: И забросаю тебя мерзостями, сделаю тебя презренною и выставлю тебя на позор.
texts.nam.3.7: И будет то, что всякий, увидев тебя, побежит от тебя и скажет: "разорена Ниневия! Кто пожалеет о ней? где найду я утешителей для тебя?"
texts.nam.3.8: Разве ты лучше Но-Аммона, находящегося между реками, окруженного водою, которого вал было море, и море служило стеною его?
texts.nam.3.9: Ефиопия и Египет с бесчисленным множеством других служили ему подкреплением; Копты и Ливийцы приходили на помощь тебе.
texts.nam.3.10: Но и он переселен, пошел в плен; даже и младенцы его разбиты на перекрестках всех улиц, а о знатных его бросали жребий, и все вельможи его окованы цепями.
texts.nam.3.11: Так и ты - опьянеешь и скроешься; так и ты будешь искать защиты от неприятеля.
texts.nam.3.12: Все укрепления твои подобны смоковнице со спелыми плодами: если тряхнуть их, то они упадут прямо в рот желающего есть.
texts.nam.3.13: Вот, и народ твой, как женщины у тебя: врагам твоим настежь отворятся ворота земли твоей, огонь пожрет запоры твои.
texts.nam.3.14: Начерпай воды на время осады; укрепляй крепости твои; пойди в грязь, топчи глину, исправь печь для обжигания кирпичей.
texts.nam.3.15: Там пожрет тебя огонь, посечет тебя меч, поест тебя как гусеница, хотя бы ты умножился как гусеница, умножился как саранча.
texts.nam.3.16: Купцов у тебя стало более, нежели звезд на небе; но эта саранча рассеется и улетит.
texts.nam.3.17: Князья твои - как саранча, и военачальники твои - как рои мошек, которые во время холода гнездятся в щелях стен, и когда взойдет солнце, то разлетаются, и не узнаешь места, где они были.
texts.nam.3.18: Спят пастыри твои, царь Ассирийский, покоятся вельможи твои; народ твой рассеялся по горам, и некому собрать его.
texts.nam.3.19: Нет врачевства для раны твоей, болезненна язва твоя. Все, услышавшие весть о тебе, будут рукоплескать о тебе, ибо на кого не простиралась беспрестанно злоба твоя?

texts.nam.1.1: Carga de Ninive. Livro da visão de Nahum, o elcoshita.
texts.nam.1.2: O Senhor é Deus zeloso e que toma vingança, o Senhor toma vingança e tem furor: o Senhor toma vingança contra os seus adversarios, e guarda a ira contra os seus inimigos.
texts.nam.1.3: O Senhor é tardio em irar-se, porém grande em força, e ao culpado não tem por innocente: o Senhor, cujo caminho é na tormenta, e na tempestade, e as nuvens são o pó dos seus pés.
texts.nam.1.4: Elle reprehende ao mar, e o faz seccar, e esgota todos os rios: desfallecem Basan e Carmelo, e a flor do Libano se murchou.
texts.nam.1.5: Os montes tremem perante elle, e os outeiros se derretem; e a terra se levanta na sua presença; e o mundo, e todos os que n’elle habitam.
texts.nam.1.6: Quem parará diante do seu furor? e quem persistirá diante do ardor da sua ira? a sua colera se derramou como um fogo, e as rochas foram por elle derribadas.
texts.nam.1.7: O Senhor é bom, elle serve de fortaleza no dia da angustia, e conhece aos que confiam n’elle.
texts.nam.1.8: E com uma inundação trasbordante acabará d’uma vez com o seu logar; e as trevas perseguirão os seus inimigos.
texts.nam.1.9: Que pensaes vós contra o Senhor? elle mesmo vos consumirá de todo: não se levantará por duas vezes a angustia.
texts.nam.1.10: Porque elles se entrelaçam como os espinhos, e se embebedam como bebados; serão inteiramente consumidos como palha secca.
texts.nam.1.11: De ti saiu um que pensou mal contra o Senhor, um conselheiro de Belial.
texts.nam.1.12: Assim diz o Senhor: Por mais seguros que estejam, e por mais numerosos que sejam, ainda assim serão tosquiados, e elle passará: eu te affligi, porém não te affligirei mais.
texts.nam.1.13: Mas agora quebrarei o seu jugo de sobre ti, e romperei os teus laços.
texts.nam.1.14: Porém contra ti o Senhor deu ordem, que mais ninguem do teu nome seja semeado: da casa do teu deus exterminarei as imagens de esculptura e de fundição: ali te farei o teu sepulchro, porque és vil.
texts.nam.1.15: Eis que sobre os montes os pés do que traz as boas novas, do que annuncia a paz! celebra as tuas festas, ó Judah, cumpre os teus votos, porque o impio não tornará mais a passar por ti: elle é inteiramente exterminado.
texts.nam.2.1: O destruidor subiu diante de ti, guarda tu a fortaleza, observa o caminho, esforça os lombos, fortalece muito a força.
texts.nam.2.2: Porque o Senhor tornará a excellencia de Jacob como a excellencia de Israel; porque os que despejam os vazaram, e corromperam os seus sarmentos.
texts.nam.2.3: Os escudos dos seus valentes serão tintos de vermelho, os homens valorosos andam vestidos de escarlate, os carros correrão como fogo de tochas no dia do seu apercebimento, e os pinheiros se abalarão.
texts.nam.2.4: Os carros se enfurecerão nas praças, discorrerão pelas ruas: o seu parecer é como o de tochas, correrão como relampagos.
texts.nam.2.5: Este se lembrará dos seus valentes, elles porém tropeçarão na sua marcha: apresentar-se-hão ao seu muro, quando o amparo fôr apparelhado.
texts.nam.2.6: As portas do rio se abrirão, e o palacio se derreterá.
texts.nam.2.7: Pois determinado está; será levada captiva, será feita subir, e as suas servas a acompanharão, gemendo como pombas, batendo em seus peitos.
texts.nam.2.8: Ninive desde que existiu tem sido como um tanque de aguas, porém ellas agora fogem. Parae, parae, clamar-se-ha; mas ninguem olhará para traz.
texts.nam.2.9: Saqueae a prata, saqueae o oiro, porque não tem termo o provimento, abastança ha de todo o genero de moveis appeteciveis.
texts.nam.2.10: Vazia, e vazada e esgotada ficará, e derreteu-se o seu coração, e tremem os joelhos, e em todos os lombos ha dôr, e os rostos de todos elles ennegrecem.
texts.nam.2.11: Onde está agora o covil dos leões, e as pastagens dos leõesinhos? onde passeava o leão velho, e o cachorro do leão, sem haver ninguem que os espantasse?
texts.nam.2.12: O leão arrebatava o que bastava para os seus cachorros, e afogava a preza para as suas leôas, e enchia de prezas as suas cavernas, e os seus covis de rapina.
texts.nam.2.13: Eis que eu estou contra ti, diz o Senhor dos exercitos, e queimarei no fumo os seus carros, e a espada devorará os teus leõesinhos, e arrancarei da terra a tua preza, e não se ouvirá mais a voz dos teus embaixadores.
texts.nam.3.1: Ai da cidade ensanguentada, que está toda cheia de mentiras e de rapina! não se aparta d’ella o roubo.
texts.nam.3.2: Estrepito de açoite ha, e o estrondo do ruido das rodas; e os cavallos atropellam, e carros vão saltando.
texts.nam.3.3: O cavalleiro levanta assim a espada flammejante, como a lança relampagueante, e ali haverá uma multidão de mortos, e abundancia de cadaveres, e não terão fim os defuntos; tropeçarão nos seus corpos;
texts.nam.3.4: Por causa da multidão das fornicações da meretriz mui graciosa, da mestra das feitiçarias, que vendeu os povos com as suas fornicações, e as gerações com as suas feitiçarias.
texts.nam.3.5: Eis que eu estou contra ti, diz o Senhor dos Exercitos, e descobrirei as tuas fraldas sobre a tua face, e ás nações mostrarei a tua nudez, e aos reinos a tua vergonha.
texts.nam.3.6: E lançarei sobre ti coisas abominaveis, e te envergonharei, e pôr-te-hei como espectaculo.
texts.nam.3.7: E ha de ser que, todos os que te virem, fugirão de ti, e dirão: Ninive está destruida, quem terá compaixão d’ella? d’onde te buscarei consoladores?
texts.nam.3.8: És tu melhor do que Nóammon, que está assentada nos rios, cercada de aguas, que tinha por esplanada o mar, cuja muralha é do mar?
texts.nam.3.9: Ethiopia e Egypto eram a sua força, e não havia fim: Put e Lybia te foram de soccorro.
texts.nam.3.10: Todavia foi levada captiva para o desterro: tambem os seus filhos são despedaçados no topo de todas as ruas, e sobre os seus honrados lançaram sortes, e todos os seus grandes foram presos com grilhões.
texts.nam.3.11: Tu tambem serás embriagada, e te esconderás; tambem buscarás força por causa do inimigo.
texts.nam.3.12: Todas as tuas fortalezas serão como figueiras com figos temporãos; se se sacodem, caem na bocca do que os ha de comer.
texts.nam.3.13: Eis que o teu povo no meio de ti será como de mulheres: as portas da tua terra estarão de todo abertas aos teus inimigos: o fogo consumirá os teus ferrolhos.
texts.nam.3.14: Tira aguas para o cerco, fortifica as tuas fortalezas, entra no lodo, e pisa o barro, repara o forno dos ladrilhos.
texts.nam.3.15: O fogo ali te consumirá, a espada te exterminará, te consumirá, como a locusta; multiplica-te como a locusta, multiplica-te como os gafanhotos.
texts.nam.3.16: Multiplicaste os teus negociantes mais do que as estrellas do céu, a locusta se espalhará e voará.
texts.nam.3.17: Os teus coroados são como os gafanhotos, e os teus chefes como os gafanhotos grandes, que se acampam nas sebes nos dias de frio; em subindo o sol voam, de sorte que não se conhece mais o logar onde estiveram.
texts.nam.3.18: Os teus pastores dormitarão, ó rei da Assyria, os teus illustres deitar-se-hão, o teu povo se derramará pelos montes; sem que haja quem o ajunte.
texts.nam.3.19: Não ha cura para a tua quebradura, a tua ferida é dolorosa: todos os que ouvirem a tua fama baterão as palmas sobre ti; porque, sobre quem não passou continuamente a tua malicia?

texts.nam.1.1: The burden of Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite,
texts.nam.1.2: God is jealous, and the LORD avengeth; the LORD avengeth, and is furious; the LORD will take vengeance on his adversaries, and he reserveth wrath for his enemies.
texts.nam.1.3: The LORD is slow to anger, and great in power, and will not at all acquit the wicked: the LORD hath his way in the whirlwind and in the storm, and the clouds are the dust of his feet.
texts.nam.1.4: He rebuketh the sea, and maketh it dry, and drieth up all the rivers: Bashan languisheth, and Carmel, and the flower of Lebanon languisheth.
texts.nam.1.5: The mountains quake at him, and the hills melt, and the earth is burned at his presence, even the world, and all that dwell therein.
texts.nam.1.6: Who can stand before his indignation? and who can abide in the fierceness of his anger? his fury is poured out like fire, and the rocks are thrown down by him.
texts.nam.1.7: The LORD is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.
texts.nam.1.8: But with an over-running flood he will make an utter end of the place thereof, and darkness shall pursue his enemies.
texts.nam.1.9: What do ye imagine against the LORD? he will make an utter end: affliction shall not rise up the second time.
texts.nam.1.10: For while they are folded together as thorns, and while they are drunken as drunkards, they shall be devoured as stubble fully dry.
texts.nam.1.11: There is one come out of thee, that imagineth evil against the LORD, a wicked counselor.
texts.nam.1.12: Thus saith the LORD; Though they are quiet, and likewise many, yet thus shall they be cut down, when he shall pass through. Though I have afflicted thee, I will afflict thee no more.
texts.nam.1.13: For now I will break his yoke from off thee, and will burst thy bonds asunder.
texts.nam.1.14: And the LORD hath given a commandment concerning thee, that no more of thy name be sown: out of the house of thy gods will I cut off the graven image and the molten image: I will make thy grave; for thou art vile.
texts.nam.1.15: Behold upon the mountains the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace! O Judah, keep thy solemn feasts, perform thy vows: for the wicked shall no more pass through thee; he is utterly cut off.
texts.nam.2.1: He that dasheth in pieces is come up before thy face: keep the munition, watch the way, make thy loins strong, fortify thy power mightily.
texts.nam.2.2: For the LORD hath turned away the excellence of Jacob, as the excellence of Israel: for the emptiers have emptied them out, and marred their vine branches.
texts.nam.2.3: The shield of his mighty men is made red, the valiant men are in scarlet: the chariots shall be with flaming torches in the day of his preparation, and the fir-trees shall be terribly shaken.
texts.nam.2.4: The chariots shall rage in the streets, they shall jostle one against another in the broad ways: they shall seem like torches, they shall run like the lightnings.
texts.nam.2.5: He shall recount his worthies: they shall stumble in their walk; they shall make haste to the wall thereof, and the defense shall be prepared.
texts.nam.2.6: The gates of the rivers shall be opened, and the palace shall be dissolved.
texts.nam.2.7: And Huzzab shall be led away captive, she shall be brought up, and her maids shall lead her as with the voice of doves, tabering upon their breasts.
texts.nam.2.8: But Nineveh is of old like a pool of water: yet they shall flee away. Stand, stand, shall they cry; but none shall look back.
texts.nam.2.9: Take ye the spoil of silver, take the spoil of gold: for there is no end of the store and glory out of all the pleasant furniture.
texts.nam.2.10: She is empty, and void, and waste: and the heart melteth, and the knees smite together, and much pain is in all loins, and the faces of them all gather blackness.
texts.nam.2.11: Where is the dwelling of the lions, and the feeding-place of the young lions, where the lion, even the old lion, walked, and the lion's whelp, and none made them afraid?
texts.nam.2.12: The lion tore in pieces enough for his whelps, and strangled for his lionesses, and filled his holes with prey, and his dens with ravin.
texts.nam.2.13: Behold, I am against thee, saith the LORD of hosts, and I will burn her chariots in the smoke, and the sword shall devour thy young lions: and I will cut off thy prey from the earth, and the voice of thy messengers shall no more be heard.
texts.nam.3.1: Woe to the bloody city! it is all full of lies and robberies; the prey departeth not;
texts.nam.3.2: The noise of a whip, and the noise of the rattling of the wheels, and of the prancing horses, and of the bounding chariots.
texts.nam.3.3: The horseman lifteth up both the bright sword, and the glittering spear: and there is a multitude of slain, and a great number of carcasses; and there is no end of their corpses; they stumble upon their corpses:
texts.nam.3.4: Because of the multitude of the lewd deeds of the well-favored harlot, the mistress of witchcrafts, that selleth nations through her lewd deeds, and families through her witchcrafts.
texts.nam.3.5: Behold, I am against thee, saith the LORD of hosts; and I will remove thy skirts upon thy face, and I will show the nations thy nakedness, and the kingdoms thy shame.
texts.nam.3.6: And I will cast abominable filth upon thee, and make thee vile, and will set thee as a gazing-stock.
texts.nam.3.7: And it shall come to pass, that all they that look upon thee shall flee from thee, and say, Nineveh is laid waste: who will bemoan her; whence shall I seek comforters for thee?
texts.nam.3.8: Art thou better than populous No, that was situated among the rivers, that had the waters around it, whose rampart was the sea, and her wall was from the sea?
texts.nam.3.9: Cush and Egypt were her strength, and it was infinite; Put and Lubim were thy helpers.
texts.nam.3.10: Yet was she carried away, she went into captivity: her young children also were dashed in pieces at the head of all the streets: and they cast lots for her honorable men, and all her great men were bound in chains.
texts.nam.3.11: Thou also shalt be drunken: thou shalt be hid, thou also shalt seek strength because of the enemy.
texts.nam.3.12: All thy strong holds shall be like fig-trees with the first ripe figs: if they be shaken, they shall even fall into the mouth of the eater.
texts.nam.3.13: Behold, thy people in the midst of thee are women: the gates of thy land shall be set wide open to thy enemies: the fire shall devour thy bars.
texts.nam.3.14: Draw thee waters for the siege, fortify thy strong holds: go into clay, and tread the mortar, make strong the brick-kiln.
texts.nam.3.15: There shall the fire devour thee; the sword shall cut thee off, it shall eat thee up like the canker-worm: make thyself many as the canker-worm, make thyself many as the locusts.
texts.nam.3.16: Thou hast multiplied thy merchants above the stars of heaven: the canker-worm spoileth, and flieth away.
texts.nam.3.17: Thy crowned are as the locusts, and thy captains as the great grasshoppers, which settle in the hedges in the cold day, but when the sun ariseth they flee away, and their place is not known where they are.
texts.nam.3.18: Thy shepherds slumber, O king of Assyria: thy nobles shall dwell in the dust: thy people are scattered upon the mountains, and no man gathereth them.
texts.nam.3.19: There is no healing of thy bruise; thy wound is grievous: all that hear the fame of thee shall clap the hands over thee: for upon whom hath not thy wickedness passed continually?

texts.nam.1.1: The burden of Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.
texts.nam.1.2: A jealous and avenging ùGod is Jehovah: an avenger is Jehovah, and full of fury: Jehovah taketh vengeance on his adversaries, and he reserveth [wrath] for his enemies.
texts.nam.1.3: Jehovah is slow to anger, and great in power, and doth not at all clear [the guilty]: Jehovah, -- his way is in the whirlwind and in the storm, and the clouds are the dust of his feet.
texts.nam.1.4: He rebuketh the sea, and maketh it dry, and drieth up all the rivers: Bashan languisheth, and Carmel, and the flower of Lebanon languisheth.
texts.nam.1.5: The mountains quake before him, and the hills melt, and the earth is upheaved at his presence, and the world, and all that dwell therein.
texts.nam.1.6: Who shall stand before his indignation? and who shall abide in the fierceness of his anger? His fury is poured out like fire, and the rocks are broken asunder by him.
texts.nam.1.7: Jehovah is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.
texts.nam.1.8: But with an overrunning flood he will make a full end of the place thereof, and darkness shall pursue his enemies.
texts.nam.1.9: What do ye imagine against Jehovah? He will make a full end: trouble shall not rise up the second time.
texts.nam.1.10: Though they be tangled together [as] thorns, and be as drenched from their drink, they shall be devoured as dry stubble, completely.
texts.nam.1.11: Out of thee is gone forth one that imagineth evil against Jehovah, a wicked counsellor.
texts.nam.1.12: Thus saith Jehovah: Though they be complete in number, and many as they be, even so shall they be cut down, and he shall pass away; and though I have afflicted thee, I will afflict thee no more.
texts.nam.1.13: And now will I break his yoke from off thee, and will burst thy bonds asunder.
texts.nam.1.14: And Jehovah hath given commandment concerning thee, that no more of thy name be sown: out of the house of thy god will I cut off the graven image, and the molten image: I will prepare thy grave; for thou art vile.
texts.nam.1.15: Behold upon the mountains the feet of him that bringeth glad tidings, that publisheth peace! Celebrate thy feasts, Judah, perform thy vows: for the wicked one shall no more pass through thee; he is utterly cut off.
texts.nam.2.1: He that dasheth in pieces is come up against thy face: keep the fortress, watch the way, make [thy] loins strong, fortify [thy] power mightily.
texts.nam.2.2: For Jehovah hath brought again the glory of Jacob, as the glory of Israel; for the wasters have wasted them, and marred their vine-branches.
texts.nam.2.3: The shield of his mighty men is made red, the valiant men are in scarlet: the chariots [glitter] with the sheen of steel, in the day of his preparation, and the spears are brandished.
texts.nam.2.4: The chariots rush madly in the streets, they justle one against another in the broad ways: the appearance of them is like torches, they run like lightnings.
texts.nam.2.5: He bethinketh him of his nobles: they stumble in their march; they make haste to the wall thereof, and the shelter is prepared.
texts.nam.2.6: The gates of the rivers are opened, and the palace melteth away.
texts.nam.2.7: And it is decreed: she shall be uncovered, she shall be led away, and her maids shall moan as with the voice of doves, drumming upon their breasts.
texts.nam.2.8: Nineveh hath been like a pool of water, since the day she existed, yet they flee away. ... Stand! Stand! But none looketh back.
texts.nam.2.9: Plunder the silver, plunder the gold; for there is no end of the splendid store of all precious vessels.
texts.nam.2.10: She is empty, and void, and waste; and the heart melteth, and the knees smite together, and writhing pain is in all loins, and all their faces grow pale.
texts.nam.2.11: Where is [now] the den of the lions, and the feeding-place of the young lions, where the lion, the lioness, [and] the lion's whelp walked, and none made them afraid?
texts.nam.2.12: The lion tore in pieces enough for his whelps, and strangled for his lionesses, and filled his holes with prey, and his dens with ravin.
texts.nam.2.13: Behold, I am against thee, saith Jehovah of hosts: and I will burn her chariots into smoke; and the sword shall devour thy young lions, and I will cut off thy prey from the earth; and the voice of thy messengers shall no more be heard.
texts.nam.3.1: Woe to the bloody city! It is all full of lies [and] violence; the prey departeth not.
texts.nam.3.2: The crack of the whip, and the noise of the rattling of the wheels, and of the prancing horses, and of the bounding chariots!
texts.nam.3.3: The horseman springing up, and the glitter of the sword, and the flash of the spear, and a multitude of slain, and a mass of carcases, and no end of corpses: they stumble over their corpses.
texts.nam.3.4: -- Because of the multitude of the fornications of the well-favoured harlot, mistress of sorceries, that selleth nations through her fornications, and families through her sorceries,
texts.nam.3.5: behold, I am against thee, saith Jehovah of hosts; and I will uncover thy skirts upon thy face, and I will shew the nations thy nakedness, and the kingdoms thy shame.
texts.nam.3.6: And I will cast abominable filth upon thee, and make thee vile, and will set thee as a gazing stock.
texts.nam.3.7: And it shall come to pass, [that] all they that see thee shall flee from thee, and shall say, Nineveh is laid waste! Who will bemoan her? whence shall I seek comforters for thee?
texts.nam.3.8: Art thou better than No-Amon, that was situate among the rivers, [that had] the waters round about her, whose rampart was the sea, [and] of the sea was her wall?
texts.nam.3.9: Ethiopia was her strength, and Egypt, and it was infinite; Phut and the Libyans were her helpers.
texts.nam.3.10: She too was carried away, she went into captivity: her infants also were dashed in pieces, at the top of all the streets; and they cast lots for her honourable men, and all her great men were bound with chains.
texts.nam.3.11: Thou also shalt be drunken: thou shalt be hid; thou also shalt seek a refuge from the enemy.
texts.nam.3.12: All thy strongholds are [like] fig-trees with the first-ripe figs: if they be shaken, they even fall into the mouth of the eater.
texts.nam.3.13: Behold, thy people in the midst of thee are [as] women: the gates of thy land are set wide open unto thine enemies; the fire devoureth thy bars.
texts.nam.3.14: Draw thee water for the siege, strengthen thy fortresses; go into the clay, and tread the mortar, make strong the brick-kiln.
texts.nam.3.15: There shall the fire devour thee; the sword shall cut thee off; it shall devour thee like the cankerworm. Make thyself many as the cankerworm, make thyself many as the locust.
texts.nam.3.16: Thou hast multiplied thy merchants more than the stars of the heavens; the cankerworm spreadeth himself out and flieth away.
texts.nam.3.17: Thy chosen men are as the locusts, and thy captains as swarms of grasshoppers, which camp in the hedges in the cold day: when the sun ariseth they flee away, and their place is not known where they are.
texts.nam.3.18: Thy shepherds slumber, O king of Assyria; thy nobles lie still; thy people are scattered upon the mountains, and no man gathereth them.
texts.nam.3.19: There is no healing of thy breach; thy wound is grievous; all that hear the report of thee clap the hands over thee; for upon whom hath not thy wickedness passed continually?

texts.nam.1.1: Burden of Nineveh. The Book of the Vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.
texts.nam.1.2: A God zealous and avenging [is] Jehovah, An avenger [is] Jehovah, and possessing fury. An avenger [is] Jehovah on His adversaries, And He is watching for His enemies.
texts.nam.1.3: Jehovah [is] slow to anger, and great in power, And Jehovah doth not entirely acquit, In a hurricane and in a tempest [is] His way, And a cloud [is] the dust of His feet.
texts.nam.1.4: He is pushing against a sea, and drieth it up, Yea, all the floods He hath made dry, Languishing [are] Bashan and Carmel, Yea, the flower of Lebanon [is] languishing.
texts.nam.1.5: Mountains have shaken because of Him, And the hills have been melted; And lifted up [is] the earth at His presence, And the world and all dwelling in it.
texts.nam.1.6: Before His indignation who doth stand? And who riseth up in the heat of His anger? His fury hath been poured out like fire, And the rocks have been broken by Him.
texts.nam.1.7: Good [is] Jehovah for a strong place in a day of distress. And He knoweth those trusting in Him.
texts.nam.1.8: And with a flood passing over, An end He maketh of its place, And His enemies doth darkness pursue.
texts.nam.1.9: What do we devise against Jehovah? An end He is making, arise not twice doth distress.
texts.nam.1.10: For while princes [are] perplexed, And with their drink are drunken, They have been consumed as stubble fully dried.
texts.nam.1.11: From thee hath come forth a deviser of evil Against Jehovah -- a worthless counsellor.
texts.nam.1.12: Thus said Jehovah: Though complete, and thus many, Yet thus they have been cut off, And he hath passed away. And I afflicted thee, I afflict thee no more.
texts.nam.1.13: And now I break his rod from off thee, And thy bands I do draw away.
texts.nam.1.14: And commanded concerning thee hath Jehovah, `No more of thy name doth spread abroad, From the house of thy gods I cut off graven and molten image, I appoint thy grave, for thou hast been vile.
texts.nam.1.15: Lo, on the mountains the feet of one proclaiming tidings, sounding peace! Celebrate, O Judah, thy festivals, complete thy vows, For add no more to pass over into thee doth the worthless, He hath been completely cut off!
texts.nam.2.1: Come up hath a scatterer to thy face, Keep the bulwark, watch the way, Strengthen the loins, strengthen power mightily.
texts.nam.2.2: For turned back hath Jehovah to the excellency of Jacob, As [to] the excellency of Israel, For emptied them out have emptiers, And their branches they have marred.
texts.nam.2.3: The shield of his mighty ones is become red, Men of might [are in] scarlet, With fiery torches [is] the chariot in a day of his preparation, And the firs have been caused to tremble.
texts.nam.2.4: In out-places shine do the chariots, They go to and fro in broad places, Their appearances [are] like torches, As lightnings they run.
texts.nam.2.5: He doth remember his honourable ones, They stumble in their goings, They hasten [to] its wall, and prepared is the covering.
texts.nam.2.6: Gates of the rivers have been opened, And the palace is dissolved.
texts.nam.2.7: And it is established -- she hath removed, She hath been brought up, And her handmaids are leading as the voice of doves, Tabering on their hearts.
texts.nam.2.8: And Nineveh [is] as a pool of waters, From of old it [is] -- and they are fleeing! `Stand ye, stand;' and none is turning!
texts.nam.2.9: Seize ye silver, seize ye gold, And there is no end to the prepared things, [To] the abundance of all desirable vessels.
texts.nam.2.10: She is empty, yea, emptiness and waste, And the heart hath melted, And the knees have smitten together, And great pain [is] in all loins, And the faces of all of them have gathered paleness.
texts.nam.2.11: Where [is] the habitation of lionesses? And a feeding-place it [is] for young lions Where walked hath a lion, an old lion, A lion's whelp, and there is none troubling.
texts.nam.2.12: The lion is tearing parts [for] his whelps, And is strangling for his lionesses, And he doth fill [with] prey his holes, And his habitations [with] rapine.
texts.nam.2.13: Lo, I [am] against thee, An affirmation of Jehovah of Hosts, And I have burned in smoke its chariot, And thy young lions consume doth a sword, And I have cut off from the land thy prey, And not heard any more is the voice of thy messengers!
texts.nam.3.1: Wo [to] the city of blood, She is all with lies -- burglary -- full, Prey doth not depart.
texts.nam.3.2: The sound of a whip, And the sound of the rattling of a wheel, And of a prancing horse, and of a bounding chariot, Of a horseman mounting.
texts.nam.3.3: And the flame of a sword, and the lightning of a spear, And the abundance of the wounded, And the weight of carcases, Yea, there is no end to the bodies, They stumble over their bodies.
texts.nam.3.4: Because of the abundance of the fornications of an harlot, The goodness of the grace of the lady of witchcrafts, Who is selling nations by her fornications, And families by her witchcrafts.
texts.nam.3.5: Lo, I [am] against thee, An affirmation of Jehovah of Hosts, And have removed thy skirts before thy face, And have shewed nations thy nakedness, And kingdoms thy shame,
texts.nam.3.6: And I have cast upon thee abominations, And dishonoured thee, and made thee as a sight.
texts.nam.3.7: And it hath come to pass, Each of thy beholders fleeth from thee, And hath said: `Spoiled is Nineveh, Who doth bemoan for her?' Whence do I seek comforters for thee?
texts.nam.3.8: Art thou better than No-Ammon, That is dwelling among brooks? Waters she hath round about her, Whose bulwark [is] the sea, waters her wall.
texts.nam.3.9: Cush her might, and Egypt, and there is no end. Put and Lubim have been for thy help.
texts.nam.3.10: Even she doth become an exile, She hath gone into captivity, Even her sucklings are dashed to pieces At the top of all out-places, And for her honoured ones they cast a lot, And all her great ones have been bound in fetters.
texts.nam.3.11: Even thou art drunken, thou art hidden, Even thou dost seek a strong place, because of an enemy.
texts.nam.3.12: All thy fortresses [are] fig-trees with first-fruits, If they are shaken, They have fallen into the mouth of the eater.
texts.nam.3.13: Lo, thy people [are] women in thy midst, To thine enemies thoroughly opened Have been the gates of thy land, Consumed hath fire thy bars.
texts.nam.3.14: Waters of a siege draw for thyself, Strengthen thy fortresses, Enter into mire, and tread on clay, Make strong a brick-kiln.
texts.nam.3.15: There consume thee doth a fire, Cut thee off doth a sword, It doth consume thee as a cankerworm! Make thyself heavy as the cankerworm, Make thyself heavy as the locust.
texts.nam.3.16: Multiply thy merchants above the stars of the heavens, The cankerworm hath stripped off, and doth flee away.
texts.nam.3.17: Thy crowned ones [are] as a locust, And thy princes as great grasshoppers, That encamp in hedges in a day of cold, The sun hath risen, and it doth flee away, And not known is its place where they are.
texts.nam.3.18: Slumbered have thy friends, king of Asshur, Rest do thine honourable ones, Scattered have been thy people on the mountains, And there is none gathering.
texts.nam.3.19: There is no weakening of thy destruction, Grievous [is] thy smiting, All hearing thy fame have clapped the hand at thee, For over whom did not thy wickedness pass continually?

texts.nam.1.1: Carga de Nínive. Libro de la visión de Nahum de Elcesía.
texts.nam.1.2: Dios celoso, y vengador Jehová, vengador Jehová, y Señor de ira. Jehová que se venga de sus adversarios, y que guarda su enojo a sus enemigos.
texts.nam.1.3: Jehová luengo de iras, y grande en poder, y absolviendo no absolverá. Jehová, cuyo camino es en tempestad y turbión, y las nubes son el polvo de sus pies.
texts.nam.1.4: Que amenaza a la mar, y la hace secar, y hace secar todos los ríos: Basán fue destruido, y el Carmelo, y la flor del Líbano fue destruida.
texts.nam.1.5: Los montes tiemblan de él, y los collados se deslien: y la tierra se abrasa delante de su presencia, y el mundo, y todos los que en él habitan.
texts.nam.1.6: ¿Quién permanecerá delante de su ira? ¿y quién quedará en pie en el furor de su enojo? su ira se derrama como fuego, y las peñas se rompen por él.
texts.nam.1.7: Bueno es Jehová para fortaleza en el día de la angustia; y que conoce a los que en él confían.
texts.nam.1.8: Y con inundación pasante hará consumación de su lugar; y tinieblas perseguirán sus enemigos.
texts.nam.1.9: ¿Qué pensáis contra Jehová? El hace consumación: no se levantará dos veces la tribulación.
texts.nam.1.10: Porque como espinas entretejidas, cuando los borrachos se emborracharán, serán consumidos del fuego, como las estopas llenas de sequedad.
texts.nam.1.11: De ti salió el que pensó mal contra Jehová, consultor impío.
texts.nam.1.12: Así dijo Jehová: Aunque reposo tengan, y así muchos como son así serán talados, y pasará; y si te afligí, no te afligiré más.
texts.nam.1.13: Porque ahora quebraré su yugo de sobre ti, romperé tus coyundas.
texts.nam.1.14: Y mandará Jehová acerca de ti, que nunca más sea sembrado alguno de tu nombre: de la casa de tu dios talaré escultura, y vaciadizo: allí pondré tu sepulcro, porque fuiste vil.
texts.nam.1.15: He aquí que sobre los montes están ya los pies del que trae las albricias, del que pregona la paz: celebra, o! Judá, tus fiestas, cumple tus votos; porque nunca más pasará por ti el impío: todo él fue talado.
texts.nam.2.1: Subió destruidor contra ti: guarda la fortaleza, mira el camino, fortifica los lomos, fortalece mucho la fuerza.
texts.nam.2.2: Porque Jehová tornará así la gloria de Jacob como la gloria de Israel; porque los vaciaron vaciadores, e hirieron sus mugrones.
texts.nam.2.3: El escudo de sus valientes será bermejo, los varones de su ejército vestidos de grana: el carro como fuego de hachas: el día que se aparejará, las hayas temblarán.
texts.nam.2.4: Los carros harán locuras en las plazas, discurrirán por las calles sus rostros como hachas: correrán como relámpagos.
texts.nam.2.5: El se acordará de sus valientes, andando tropezarán cuando se apresuraren a su muro, y la cubierta se aparejare.
texts.nam.2.6: Las puertas de los ríos se abrirán, y el palacio será destruido.
texts.nam.2.7: Y la reina fue cautiva, mandarle han que suba; y sus criadas la llevarán, gimiendo como palomas, batiendo sus pechos.
texts.nam.2.8: Y fue Nínive de tiempo antiguo como estanque de aguas: mas ellos ahora huyen: Parád, parád; y ninguno mira.
texts.nam.2.9: Saqueád plata, saqueád oro: no hay fin de las riquezas: honra, más que todo ajuar de codicia.
texts.nam.2.10: Vacía, y agotada, y despedazada quedará, y el corazón derretido: batimiento de rodillas, y dolor en todos riñones; y las haces de todos ellos tomarán negrura.
texts.nam.2.11: ¿Qué es de la morada de los leones, y de la majada de los cachorros de leones, donde se recogía el león y la leona, y los cachorros del león; y no había quien les pusiese miedo?
texts.nam.2.12: El león arrebataba asaz para sus cachorros, y ahogaba para sus leonas; y henchía de presa sus cavernas, y de robo sus moradas.
texts.nam.2.13: He aquí yo hablo a ti, dijo Jehová de los ejércitos, que encenderé con humo tus carros, y a tus leoncillos tragará espada; y raeré de la tierra tu robo, y nunca más se oirá voz de tus embajadores.
texts.nam.3.1: ¡Ay de la ciudad de sangres! toda llena de mentira y de rapiña, no se aparta de ella robo.
texts.nam.3.2: Sonido de azote, y estruendo de movimiento de ruedas, y caballo atropellador, y carro saltador se oirá en ti.
texts.nam.3.3: Caballero enhiesto, y resplandor de espada, y resplandor de lanza; y multitud de muertos, y multitud de cuerpos; y en sus cuerpos no habrá fin, y en sus cuerpos tropezarán.
texts.nam.3.4: Por la multitud de las fornicaciones de la ramera de hermosa gracia, maestra de hechizos, que vende las naciones con sus fornicaciones, y los pueblos con sus hechizos.
texts.nam.3.5: He aquí yo a ti, dijo Jehová de los ejércitos, que yo descubriré tus faldas en tu haz, y mostraré a las naciones tu desnudez, y a los reinos tu vergüenza.
texts.nam.3.6: Y echaré sobre ti suciedades, y avergonzarte he; y ponerte he como estiércol.
texts.nam.3.7: Y será que todos los que te vieren, se apartarán de ti, y dirán: Nínive es asolada, ¿quién se compadecerá de ella? ¿Dónde te buscaré consoladores?
texts.nam.3.8: ¿Eres tú mejor que No la populosa, que está asentada entre ríos, cercada de aguas, su baluarte es la mar: de mar es su muralla?
texts.nam.3.9: Etiopía su fortaleza, y Egipto sin término: Africa y Libia fueron en tu ayuda.
texts.nam.3.10: También ella fue en cautividad, en cautividad: también sus chiquitos fueron estrellados por las encrucijadas de todas las calles; y sobre sus honrados echaron suertes, y todos sus nobles fueron aprisionados con grillos.
texts.nam.3.11: Tú también serás emborrachada, serás encerrada: tú también buscarás fortaleza a causa del enemigo.
texts.nam.3.12: Todas tus fortalezas son como higos y brevas: que si las remecen, caen en la boca del que las ha de comer.
texts.nam.3.13: He aquí que tu pueblo será como mujeres en medio de ti: las puertas de tu tierra abriendo se abrirán a tus enemigos, fuego consumirá tus barras.
texts.nam.3.14: Provéete de agua para el cerco, fortifica tus fortalezas, entra en el lodo, pisa el barro, fortifica el horno.
texts.nam.3.15: Allí te consumirá el fuego, te talará la espada, tragará como pulgón: multiplícate como pulgón, multiplícate como langosta.
texts.nam.3.16: Multiplicaste tus mercaderes más que las estrellas del cielo: el pulgón hizo presa, y voló.
texts.nam.3.17: Tus príncipes serán como langostas, y tus grandes como langostas de langostas que se asientan en vallados en día de frío: salido el sol se mudan, y no se conoce el lugar donde estuvieron.
texts.nam.3.18: Durmieron tus pastores, o! rey de Asiria reposaron tus valientes: tu pueblo se derramó por los montes, y no hay quien le junte.
texts.nam.3.19: No hay cura para tu quebradura: tu herida se encrudeció: todos los que oyeren tu fama, batirán las manos sobre ti; porque, ¿sobre quién no pasó continuamente tu malicia?

texts.nam.1.1: The oracle, on Nineveh,—the scroll of the vision of Nahum, the Elkoshite.
texts.nam.1.2: A GOD jealous and avenging, is Yahweh, an avenger, is Yahweh, and a lord of wrath, an avenger, is Yahweh towards his adversaries, and, a retainer [of anger], is he to his foes.
texts.nam.1.3: Yahweh, is slow to anger, but great in vigour, He will not leave, unpunished, as for Yahweh, in storm-wind and in tempest, is his way, and, clouds, are the dust of his feet.
texts.nam.1.4: Who rebuketh the sea and hath made it dry, and, all the streams, hath he dried up,—withered are Bashan and Carmel, Even the bloom of Lebanon, is withered:
texts.nam.1.5: Mountains, have trembled because of him, and, the hills, have melted,—and the earth, hath lifted itself up, at his presence, the world also, and all who dwell therein.
texts.nam.1.6: Before his indignation, who shall stand? And who shall abide the glow of his anger? His wrath, hath been poured forth like fire, and, the rocks, have been broken down because of him.
texts.nam.1.7: Good is Yahweh, as a protection in the day of distress,—and one who acknowledgeth them who seek refuge in him.
texts.nam.1.8: But, with an overflow rolling on, a full end, will he make of them who rise up against him,—and, his foes, will he pursue into darkness.
texts.nam.1.9: What can ye devise against Yahweh? A full end, is he making,—Distress, shall not rise up twice:
texts.nam.1.10: Though they were like thorns intertwined, and as drunkards drenched with their drink, yet have they been devoured, like stubble fully dry.
texts.nam.1.11: Out of thee, hath one come forth—plotting, against Yahweh, wickedness,—A counselor of the Abandoned One.
texts.nam.1.12: Thus, saith Yahweh, Though they be in full force, and so in great numbers, yet, even so, have they been cut off, and have passed away,—If I humble thee [once], I will not humble thee again.
texts.nam.1.13: Now, therefore, will I break his yoke from off thee,—and, thy fetters, will I tear off.
texts.nam.1.14: Then will Yahweh give command concerning thee, None of thy name shall be sown any more,—out of the house of thy gods, will I cut off carved image and molten image, I will appoint thy grave, for thou art of little esteem.
texts.nam.1.15: Lo! upon the mountains, The feet of one, who bringeth Good Tidings! who publisheth Prosperity! Celebrate, O Judah, thy pilgrim festivals, fulfil thy vows, for, not again, any more, shall the Abandoned One, pass through thee, he hath been wholly cut off.
texts.nam.2.1: He that breaketh in pieces hath come up over thy face, Keep the keeps,—watch the way, brace the loins, make vigour very firm.
texts.nam.2.2: For Yahweh hath restored the excellency of Jacob, like the excellency of Israel,—for the plunderers have plundered them, and, their vine branches, have they marred.
texts.nam.2.3: The shield of his heroes, is made red, the men of war, are clad in crimson, on fire, are the chariot-steels, on the day he maketh ready,—and, the lances, are put in motion.
texts.nam.2.4: In the streets, madly go the chariots, they rush along in the broadways,—their appearance, is like torches, as lightnings, hither and thither do they run.
texts.nam.2.5: Let him call to mind his nobles, they shall stumble as they go—let them hasten to her wall, yet the storming cover, is prepared.
texts.nam.2.6: The gates of the rivers, have been opened,—and, the palace, doth quake.
texts.nam.2.7: And, Huzzab, hath been taken captive—hath been led up,—and, her handmaids, are making a moan like the sound of doves, as they taber upon their heart.
texts.nam.2.8: Yet, as for Nineveh, like a reservoir of waters, are her waters,—but, those men, are in flight! Stand! stand!! but no one is turning.
texts.nam.2.9: Plunder silver, plunder gold,—and there is no end to the costly furnishing, rich with every article of delight.
texts.nam.2.10: Emptiness, yea turned to emptiness, aye deserted [is she]! with, heart, unnerved, and, a tottering, of knees, and, anguish, in all loins, and, the faces of them all, have withdrawn their colour.
texts.nam.2.11: Where is the lair of the lions? Yea the very feeding-place of the young lions,—where walked the lion, the lioness, the lion’s whelp, with none to make them afraid?
texts.nam.2.12: The lion, used to tear in pieces enough for his whelps, and to strangle for his lionesses,—and then fill with prey his holes, and his lairs with what he had torn.
texts.nam.2.13: Behold me! against thee, Declareth Yahweh of hosts, Therefore will I burn up in smoke her chariots, and, thy young lions, shall be devoured by the sword,—so will I cut off, out of the earth, thy prey, nor shall be heard any more, the voice of thine envoy.
texts.nam.3.1: Alas for the city of bloodshed! All of it, deceit, of violence full, none releaseth prey!
texts.nam.3.2: The sound of the whip, and the sound of the rushing wheel,—and horse galloping, and dancing chariot rattling along.
texts.nam.3.3: Horsemen uplifting both the flashing sword, and the lightning spear, Aye, a mass of slain, and a weight of dead bridles,—and no end of corpses, so that they stumble upon their corpses.
texts.nam.3.4: Because of the multitude of the unchaste doings of the unchaste one, fair in grace, mistress of secret arts,—who hath been selling nations by her unchaste doings, families by her secret arts,
texts.nam.3.5: Behold me! against thee, Declareth Yahweh of hosts, Therefore will I remove thy shirts over thy face,—and let, nations, see thy nakedness, and, kingdoms, thy shame;
texts.nam.3.6: And I will cast upon thee abominable filth, and treat thee as foolish,—and set thee as a gazing-stock.
texts.nam.3.7: And it shall come to pass that, all who see thee, shall flee from thee, and shall say, Destroyed is Nineveh! Who will bemoan her?—Whence shall I seek any to comfort thee?
texts.nam.3.8: Art thou better than No-amon, who sat among the Nile-streams, waters round about her,—whose fortress was the sea, from the sea, her wall.
texts.nam.3.9: Ethiopia, was her strength, and Egypt—Yea, without end,—Put and Lubim, were among thy helpers.
texts.nam.3.10: Yet, she, was given up to exile, she went into captivity, even her babes, were dashed to the ground, at the head of all the streets,—and, for her honourable men, cast they lots, and, all her great men, were bound together in chains.
texts.nam.3.11: Thou too, shalt be drunken, thou shalt hide thyself,—thou too, shalt seek shelter from the foe:
texts.nam.3.12: All thy fortresses, shall be fig-trees with first-ripe figs: if thy be shaken, then shall [the fruit] fall on the mouth of the eater.
texts.nam.3.13: Lo! thy people, are women, in thy midst, to thy foes, have been set wide open the gates of thy and,—a fire, hath devoured, thy bars.
texts.nam.3.14: Siege-water, draw for thyself, strengthen thy fortresses,—go into the clay, and tread thou the mortar, make strong the brick.
texts.nam.3.15: There, shall a fire devour thee, the sword, shall cut thee off, it shall devour thee like the grass locust, make thyself numerous like the grass locust, make thyself numerous as the swarming locust:
texts.nam.3.16: Though thou have multiplied thy foot-soldiers beyond the stars of the heavens, the grass locust, hath stript itself and flown away!
texts.nam.3.17: Thy mercenary crowds, are like the swarming locust, and, thy mixed multitudes, like locusts—swarms of locusts,—which settle in the hedges on a cold day, the sun, hath broken forth, and they are in flight, and unknown is the place where they are!
texts.nam.3.18: Asleep are thy shepherds, O king of Assyria, thy nobles, must needs rest. Scattered are thy people upon the mountains, and there is none to gather them.
texts.nam.3.19: No lessening of thine injury, grievous is thy wound,—all who have heard the report of thee, have clapped their hands over thee, for, upon whom, hath not thy cruelty passed without ceasing?

texts.nam.1.1: Profecía sobre Nínive. Libro de la visión de Nahúm de Elcos.
texts.nam.1.2: Yahvé es Dios celoso y vengador; Yahvé es vengador y lleno de indignación; Yahvé se venga de sus adversarios y guarda el enojo para sus enemigos.
